heading: Mechanical engineering for systems across industrial applications.
lead: My design process starts with the physical system: how it fits, how it’s built, how it’s accessed, and how it behaves in use.
body: Vehicle electrical integration, manufacturing work, and engineering data tooling support that foundation. Across Formula EV, industrial controls, and asset-integrity work, I have contributed where packaging, hardware, testing, process, and communication meet.

signals.label: DESIGN WITH THE USER IN MIND
signals.text: Vehicle packaging, panel drawings, physical assembly, and preliminary fabrication keeps the practical constraints visible early.

signals.label: CLOSE THE LOOP WITH TESTING AND ITERATION
signals.text: QA checks, troubleshooting, inspection planning, and operating-data analysis turn observations into engineering decisions.

signals.label: MAKE THE WORK TRANSFERABLE
signals.text: Diagrams, scope packages, dashboards, and repeatable tools help technicians, operations teams, and other engineers use the result.
